title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.

Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation

Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.
  • Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
  • Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
  • Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Hr training analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Careers & university coordinator
description:
Careers & University Coordinator (Whole School)
Key responsibilities:
Strategic leadership and curriculum development Curriculum Development: Develop and implement a progressive careers curriculum, integrating it with the school's IB programs and collaborating with Pastoral Leads and IB Coordinators to embed careers and life skills into the pastoral framework. Training and Management: Lead the training and development of Year 12 and 13 Tutors and Heads of Year to provide consistent, high-quality university application support, ideally maintaining the same staff with each cohort for continuity. Technology Integration: Manage and utilize an online central hub for all careers resources, communications, and student progress tracking. Technology Integration: Ensure careers counselors have the tools and assessments needed to evaluate students’ strengths and interests, guiding them toward suitable academic and career pathways. Higher education guidance and admissions: International admissions expertise : Provide expert guidance on domestic and international university applications, with strong knowledge of UCAS (UK), the Common Application (US), European systems, and the Brazilian Vestibular process, while maintaining close relationships with university admissions departments. Specialized counseling: Provide targeted support for highly competitive applications, including Oxbridge-level counselling for the University of Oxford, the University of Cambridge, and Ivy League/top-tier US institutions. Application management: Oversee all aspects of the application process, including setting and enforcing deadlines for student and teacher components, and ensuring transcript quality and accuracy. Events, outreach, and student experience: Parent presentations : Design and deliver parent presentations that clearly communicate admissions processes, funding options, and career pathways. Alumni and local experts network : Support the development and maintenance of a strong alumni and local expert network to provide mentoring, career insights, and resources for current students. School communication: Ensure timely and effective communication regarding all career sevents, deadlines, and news across the whole school.
International Cultural Developmen t: Support the school leadership team in promoting global citizenship, international mindedness, and aspirations for international study.
Requirements
Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential to effectively guide students and communicate with both local and international universities and parents.
Proven teaching experience at the secondary level, preferably within the IB framework.
Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, International Relations, HR or related fields, besides proven experience and demonstrable knowledge of the UCAS, US, European, and Brazilian university admissions processes.
Proven ability to build a comprehensive strategic vision in partnership with leadership colleagues to create buy-in from stakeholders and hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-today delivery of this vision.
Exceptional ability to build rapport with students, parents, university representatives, and colleagues. Strong oral and written communication skills.
Excellent organizational, administrative, and project management skills.

description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.
Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.
Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.
Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!
Como será seu dia a dia aqui:
Reportando-se ao Gerente de Loja, sua principal responsabilidade será prestar suporte geral a loja, com atendimento em caixa, apoio aos vendedores, controles administrativos, organização de estoque, possibilitando uma boa experiência do cliente em visita e consumo da loja, além do controle e organização seguindo os procedimentos e as políticas internas da CK.
Além disso você também será responsável por:
Processar as vendas de produtos no momento da compra do cliente, ofertando produtos adicionais para a venda agregada no caixa;
Dar suporte aos vendedores durante o atendimento aos clientes, acompanhando necessidades de busca de produtos, verificando se o cliente precisa de algum apoio, oferecendo conforto e acolhimento com café, água, guarda de volumes e demais condições disponíveis pela loja.
Manter os produtos da loja alarmados, repostos, precificados, controlados e passados, verificando as necessidades de arrumação de estoque, araras, gavetas, frente de loja e demais locais de exposição ou armazenamento de produtos, efetuando ou acompanhando contagens de inventário, movimentando os itens quando necessário e respeitando os padrões e orientações tanto de Visual Merchandising quanto da liderança imediata.
Habilidades e requisitos:
Comunicação
Relacionamento
Estilo
Atitude
Curiosidade
Foco em Resultados
Autenticidade
Ensino Médio Completo Seria ótimo se você também tivesse...
Experiência anterior na função
Conhecimento no sistema Linx
Informações adicionais:
Modelo de trabalho: Presencial
Horário: 44h semanais (6x1)
Você vai encontrar por aqui:
ALIMENTAÇÃO:
Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação (você escolhe)
TRANSPORTE:
Vale-transporte
SAÚDE:
Assistência médica Amil (várias opções disponíveis)
Assistência odontológica Amil
Seguro de Vida
BEM-ESTAR:
CK4 YOU (programa exclusivo CK, com aulas, palestras e eventos direcionados ao bem-estar dos colaboradores)
Com Psych (atendimento psicológico e jurídico disponível para você e seus familiares)
Headspace e Virgin Pulse (app de bem-estar para ajudar a manter uma rotina saudável)
Psicologia na Tela (Conexa)
PARA ECONOMIZAR E ORGANIZAR SEU DINHEIRO:
Desconto farmácia
Empréstimo Consignado
PARA APRENDER CADA DIA MAIS:
PVH University e Linkedin Learning (acesso a vários cursos na nossa plataforma exclusiva, todos gratuitos!)
Treinamentos em várias áreas e para todos os níveis hierárquicos
... E TEM MAIS!
Day off de aniversário (um dia para relaxar no mês do seu aniversário)
Desconto em produtos CK (descontão heim!)
Kit baby (futuros papais e mamães ganham presentinhos)
Ações de endomarketing (o ano todo temos palestras, rodas de conversa, eventos e muito mais!)
Plano de Saúde Pet
E não para por aí...#vempra CK para conferir!

title: Analista de seguros júnior -vaga exclusiva para pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Atividades:
Realizar atendimentos aos clientes, respondendo a dúvidas, fornecendo informações e auxiliando em suas necessidades.
Verificar a conformidade dos processos de atendimento de acordo com as diretrizes e padrões estabelecidos.
Auxiliar na identificação de melhorias com base nos registros de atendimentos.
Colaborar com as equipes de atendimento e outras áreas para resolver problemas.
Acompanhar métricas e elaborar relatórios e apresentações.
Prestar suporte em cotações de seguros.
Controlar e resolver pendências de propostas e apólices de seguros.
Monitorar a regulação de sinistros.
Atualizar sistemas internos e planilhas de controle.
Requisitos:
Ensino Superior completo.
Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel.
Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
Proatividade, com capacidade de antecipar etapas e considerar possíveis desdobramentos.
Experiência no mercado de seguros.
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e atividades administrativas.

Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.
Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

No seu dia-a-dia:
Realizar as atividades de vendas corporativas, planos e iniciativas de gestão e relacionamento comercial com clientes diferenciados com médio impacto financeiro, realizando prospecções e ofertas, entendendo necessidades realizando contatos e visitas para mapeamento e/ou monitoramento da qualidade e grau de satisfação dos produtos adquiridos da Seguros Unimed, buscando e avaliando informações que permitam a criação, atendimento a novas demandas e promoção de alterações em contratos/condições comerciais e/ou no desenvolvimento/produção de produtos, assegurando nível de satisfação e continuidade de contratos;
Realizar visitas aos clientes, identificar e oferecer através de análise do potencial de negócios do cliente, novos serviços, buscando alavancar negócios de pós vendas, desenvolvendo soluções para renovações e up grade das contas ativas da Cia;

Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed;
Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações;
Realizar vendas de produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados;
Manter cadastro de clientes atualizado, bem como manter-se informado do potencial e situação financeira dos mesmos;
Identificar novas demandas externas, quais as necessidades e o potencial do mercado, desenvolvendo novos clientes e buscando continuamente novas oportunidades de negócios para a empresa;
Promover e fortalecer a imagem da empresa no mercado, cumprindo a estratégia e plano de ações de marketing, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de divulgação e disseminação dos produtos, soluções e marca, monitorando efetividade das ações mercadológicas;
Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;

Participar ativamente de programas de melhoria da qualidade dos produtos, serviços e meio ambiente, cumprir as normas internas e de segurança do trabalho;
Prestar suporte aos clientes e parceiros, no que se refere às peculiaridades da empresa, contribuindo com a melhoria dos serviços a serem prestados;
Buscar a geração de novas oportunidades, mediante identificação dos pontos que podem ser trabalhados no cliente, imaginando e propondo soluções;

Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas. Quem procuramos

Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;

Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Contract clinical research associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)
Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.
About Clinergy
Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.
Role Description
We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.
Activities
Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
Verify the accuracy of study results;
Identify and resolve site issues; Requirements
Bachelor's degree in life sciences;
2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
Advanced/Fluent in English;
Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices Skills
Self driven individual
Sense of urgency
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Good problem solving skills
Enthusiastic and energetic To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to

title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Frontend engineer – next.js / react
description:

We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Admanage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend. Our mission? Level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

You'll collaborate with the founding team (ex-Photoroom, ex-ZOE, ex-Nextdoor), shape our frontend architecture, and raise the bar for state management, testing, and performance.
You're not here to maintain, you're here to build a complex UI that's robust and well-tested.

Testing: Vitest
Backend (light exposure): Node.js, Prisma, My SQL
Infra: R2 Cloudfalre, AWS S3, Vercel

APIs: Facebook Marketing API, Tik Tok Ads API
What You'll Do
Architect and scale the frontend for an app launching 900,000+ ads/month
Implement robust state management to handle complex, async, and data-heavy workflows
Build production-grade testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2 E) to support safe continuous deployment
Ship features end-to-end: idea → build → optimize for robust testing, speed and UX
You Might Be a Fit If You...
Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.js apps
Are skilled at state management in large, complex apps
Believe testing is part of building, not an afterthought
Care about performance, UX, and clean design systems
Communicate clearly, move fast, and thrive in a startup culture
Bonus Points For
Experience with ad APIs (Meta, Tik Tok, IG)
Prisma + My SQL experience
CI/CD pipeline knowledge (Vercel, Git Hub Actions)
Join Us If You Want To...
Build alongside experienced engineers and founders
Work with a modern stack and ship fast
Solve hard UX and state management challenges in adtech
Own what you build and shape our engineering culture
Grow into a Lead role as the company scales
How to Apply
Send your Git Hub, Linked In, and 2-3 lines on the hardest frontend problem you've solved lately. Bonus: links to anything you've built that makes you proud.
Interview Process
We start with a take home task where you'll be asked to identify bugs in a sample github repo and indicate how you would fix it.

Identificar oportunidades e riscos que possam impactar o portfólio, monitorando o mercado e a concorrência através de benchmarking e estudos de tendências, visando manter a competitividade da empresa e antecipar movimentos do mercado.

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.

Barra da Tijuca (Av. Embaixador Abelardo Bueno), Rio de Janeiro.

Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:
- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.

title: Head of gtm & growth | valere evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve
Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.
The Role
As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.
You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.
This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.
Impact You Will Have
Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones Key Responsibilities
GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities What We Look For
Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2 B and B2 B2 C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade How to Apply
To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:
A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute. Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Quality assurance tester
description:
Position: QA Lead / Test Engineer ( Remote)
Location: Rio Di Janeiro, Brazil
Duration - Full time
Salary - Competitive
Job Description
Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.
In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.
When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will
Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, Event Bridge).
Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e. G. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Git Hub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features. Who we are looking for
Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, and Event Bridge.
Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or Type Script for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e. G. JIRA, Browser Stack).
Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. We offer
We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Identificar oportunidades e riscos que possam impactar o portfólio, monitorando o mercado e a concorrência através de benchmarking e estudos de tendências, visando manter a competitividade da empresa e antecipar movimentos do mercado.
Apoiar no cronograma de projetos de inovação de novos produtos, através da análise e consolidação de dados, visando garantir o cumprimento de prazos.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT

About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.

Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.

LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.

title: Analista De Ti Sênior (Administrador De Redes)
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.

Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificaçõesdesejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.

EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS

  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridadecom segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade dediagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridadecom soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO

Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.

Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novastecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar dadefinição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.

Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio creche
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
